# Mubashir Sakhi

> Multi-hyphenate operator and builder based in Karachi, Pakistan. Works across
> four tracks: live event production, wholesale renewable energy, software, and
> startup community. Co-founder of Streamguys and operator at Enova. Founder of
> Tech Geeks of Pakistan (12,000+ members). NED University engineering graduate.

Hire-relevant summary: a generalist executor rather than a specialist. Track
record spans launching and running ventures end to end — brand, ops, tech, and
distribution — not a single functional lane.

## Current work

- **Streamguys** (co-founder, 2020–present) — live event production and
  real-time social media content across Pakistan. Notable events: WOW Festival
  (British Council Pakistan), 021Disrupt.
- **Renewable energy** — wholesale distribution. Previously built the operating
  surface for Enova, a B2B renewable-energy brand (solar panels, inverters,
  lithium batteries, 12V DC and lighting).
- **Software** — JavaScript and Node.js, REST APIs, open-source projects.
- **Advisory** — helps early startups validate ideas with no-code tools before
  committing to engineering.

## Background

- **Tech Geeks of Pakistan** — founder, 12,000+ member community.
- **The Nest I/O** — Entrepreneur in Residence, 2017–2020.
- **Two Dots Design Studio** — Managing Partner; acquired by 10Pearls.
- **Wrapkar** — co-founder, vehicle wrapping startup, raised $10K, 5,000+
  vehicles wrapped.
- **NED University of Engineering & Technology** — engineering graduate, GPA 3.445.
